cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.
